tasks.description: The login flow should be defined to ensure secure and seamless access to the customer portal. This includes determining the authentication methods and authorization protocols. The definition should be based on industry best practices and security standards.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid username and password, when the user attempts to log in, then they are redirected to the dashboard.

tasks.description: The report types that will be available in the customer portal need to be listed. This includes determining the types of data that will be included in each report and the frequency of report generation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of available reports, when the user selects a report, then the report is generated with the correct data.

tasks.description: The notification settings for the customer portal need to be described. This includes determining the types of notifications that will be sent and the frequency of notification delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of notification preferences, when the user updates their preferences, then the notifications are sent according to the updated preferences.

tasks.description: The background section of the customer portal document needs to be written. This includes providing context and history about the customer portal and its purpose.
acceptance_criteria: Given the background section, when the user reads the section, then they understand the context and purpose of the customer portal.

tasks.description: The acceptance criteria for the customer portal need to be defined. This includes determining the test cases and scenarios that will be used to verify the functionality of the portal.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of test cases, when the test cases are executed, then the results match the expected outcomes.
